lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance, roughly circular blobs arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with a higher concentration of smaller spots located dorsally near the head-to-body transition.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with high intensity on the upper edge and lower intensity/shadow on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin shows a high density of small, high-luminance spots, which are significantly smaller and more closely packed than those on the main body flank.
